title: Ethereal Dreamscape
description: Replaces the vanilla sleep screen with immersive, cinematic dream narratives and atmospheric visual effects.
body:
## Ethereal Dreamscape: Narrative Sleep Overhaul
Ethereal Dreamscape is a total reimagining of the sleeping mechanic in Minecraft. Instead of a simple skip-to-dawn, every night becomes a journey into the subconscious of your character, turning a routine action into a cinematic storytelling experience.

### ✨ Key Features:
150+ Unique Narrative Visions: Discover a vast library of poetic and mysterious dreams. From encounters with ancient kings to whispers from the void, no two nights feel the same.

**Cinematic Immersion:**
Experience a complete visual isolation. The world fades away, replaced by a deep void filled with drifting mystical particles and pulsing ancient text.

**True RPG Depth:**
Perfectly suited for RPG and Hardcore modpacks. It adds a layer of roleplay and "lore-feeling" that makes your world feel alive and reactive to your character's journey.

**Enhanced Atmosphere:** 
Subtle visual effects like "Magic Dust" particles and soft text glows create a meditative, high-end aesthetic.

**Player Control:** 
You are no longer forced awake by the server. Stay in the dream as long as you wish to finish the story; wake up only when you are ready by pressing ESC.

Full Localization: Optimized for global players with built-in support for English and Russian.

## 🎮 Why add this to your Modpack?
Standard sleeping is a technical pause; Ethereal Dreamscape is a narrative reward. It enhances the "soul" of your gameplay, making the nighttime something to look forward to rather than avoid. Whether you are building a medieval kingdom or surviving a gothic horror world, these dreams provide the perfect atmospheric bridge between days.
